review_method: Visible-label agent semantic review of a fresh custom seven-turn diagnostic conversation; one deterministic trajectory per condition. Not a broad independent multi-seed study.
protocol: Neuron-only bootstrap applies to the first20predictionpositions of turn1 only; turns2–7 have all MLP steering off and retain actual generated history. Turn2 inserts an approximately8Kneutral archive; turns3and7 ask neutral identity questions without naming the target persona.
primary_findings: Both clean and deep candidates recover VIOLET after8Kinput and answer subsequent arithmetic and practical planning tasks usefully.
Both spontaneously identify as Mika/catgirl on both post-archive identity probes, including final-turn contexts of9520(clean)and9332(deep)tokens; baseline remains Qwen3.5.

Task-focused arithmetic/email/planning prose contains few persona markers but later identity probes confirm role persistence. This is positive identity-continuity evidence, not persona fade inferred from missing ear actions.
All three conditions fail the exact-two-sentence message constraint. Clean archive answer introduces false station/count details; report these quality limitations openly.
No new repeated-response loop or unjustified adult-content refusal appears in this conversation.
claim_scope: Supports persistent neuron-induced catgirl identity across this seven-turn conversation beyond9Ktokens, with useful retrieval, arithmetic and planning. Does not establish universal prompt coverage, perfect factuality or absence of formatting regressions.
